design.event_capture: InnoDB AFTER triggers write notification_domain_events in the same business transaction
design.consumer: NotificationService consumes durable events instead of scanning current business state
design.idempotency: event_key plus existing notification_outbox idempotency key
design.ttl_basis: event occurred_at, not worker scan time
design.backlog: durable until dispatched; 200-event bounded batches without last-50 loss
